_meta: Shape defined by docs/08-manifest-schema.md. This is content, not mechanism — a second project supplies its own file, not this one.

bible.public: Fearless, always has a joke ready.
bible.private: Gets scared like anyone else; hides it so the player doesn't worry.
bible.secret: Rehearses her jokes under her breath before she says them out loud, so they land.
bible.fear: That she's more annoying than helpful and gets left behind.
bible.desire: To actually matter to the player — not be tolerated, needed.

archetypes._status: ranges are a first-pass sketch (stern/professional profile), not yet validated against a trained model. corpus_ref is unset until M8 task #10 (guard corpus + retrain) exists. name_gen resolved to a compiled-in name array (NPCDatabase::GUARD_ARCHETYPE), not a loaded text file — same pattern as MOODS/CONTEXTS in the same file.
